p0_frontend_initialization.summary: Restored missing setupDiscoverHandlers() and setupHealthHandlers() in app/ui/index.html. Verified browser initialization executes with zero uncaught JavaScript errors.

schema_designer_workflow.summary: Deterministic presets load reliably on startup; added actionable validation toast when no object/need is selected; preserved complete adopt-and-fill roundtrip workflow.

relationships_controlled_filter.summary: Replaced freeform text filter with controlled select populated from Scope inventory; includes All Properties default, usage counts, and loading indicators.

refactor_controlled_target.summary: Replaced generic target input with operation-aware controlled controls: Combobox of existing properties + explicit new name creation input for Rename/Merge, target type select for Convert Type, and real-time name collision warning banner.

note_workspace_collapsible_folder_tree.summary: Implemented collapsible hierarchical folder tree with expand/collapse-all controls, removing 100-note arbitrary truncation to support unlimited notes comfortably across deep folder hierarchies.

property_human_readable_vocabulary_layer.summary: Implemented app/core/property_glossary.py with 49 built-in standard properties, presentation-only bilingual labels, safe custom-property fallback, universal ⓘ button, and rich contextual Help Drawer.

refactor_normalize_value_mapping.summary: Enhanced refactor planner with Scope observed-value controlled mapping table (REQ-038) and structured human-readable plan summary.

note_workspace_badges_and_health_integra.summary: Integrated presentation badges and ⓘ Help Drawer into Note Properties Workspace, Semantic Diff, and Property Health findings.

benchmark_evidence_architecture.summary: Guarded benchmark evidence writing behind PROPERTY_STUDIO_WRITE_BENCHMARK_EVIDENCE=1 to eliminate evidence drift during regular pytest runs.
